title: selaginella debilis
intro: Selaginella debilis, commonly known as Spiny Club Fern, is a type of evergreen, flowering plant that belongs to the Selaginellaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate conditions like arthritis and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella debilis include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its potential to act as an immunomodulator and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
